# mintswarm repository config for this repository.
# A first cut used while dogfooding: the shape follows the decisions on #3,
# the final schema comes with the contracts work.

tracker:
  kind: github
  kinds:
    source: issue_types              # issue_types | labels
    design:         { issue_type: Design }
    plan:           { issue_type: Plan }
    implementation: { issue_type: Task }
  components:
    source: labels                   # labels (per repository) | field (account-wide select or free text)
    label: "component:{name}"        # implementation issues carry exactly one; design and plan issues may carry several
  # state, plan_verdict and decomp_verdict are read from the base ref, never the worktree, by
  # .mintswarm/dogfood/github/msw-state.py. Fields are named, never given by id: msw-state.py
  # resolves the ids per account into its cache outside the repository (see "Field ids" in
  # .mintswarm/dogfood/github/README.md).
  state:
    source: field                    # field (organisation issue field, single select) | labels
    field: msw-state                 # field mode only
    label: "msw-state:{value}"       # labels mode: exactly one per issue the session has touched
    status: issue_status             # issue_status (GitHub issue statuses, mapped from the value) | off
  # The approval stages' verdicts; the values are the five band identifiers:
  # blocked, uncertain, needs-review, likely-safe, safe.
  plan_verdict:                      # the plan assessment's band
    source: field                    # field | labels
    field: msw-plan                  # field mode only
    label: "msw-plan:{value}"        # labels mode: exactly one per issue
  decomp_verdict:                    # the decomposition assessment's band
    source: field                    # field | labels
    field: msw-decomp                # field mode only
    label: "msw-decomp:{value}"      # labels mode: exactly one per issue
  # Field mappings per role (size here); each role fixes its read point in code (size: the job's pinned base).
  # A field is named, never given by id: its id is resolved from the name and cached, never written here.
  fields:
    size:
      source: field                  # field | labels | off
      field: Effort
      label: "effort:{option}"       # labels mode only
      default: M                     # also the fallback value
      options:
        XS:  { range: XS }
        S:   { range: S }
        M:   { range: M }
        L:   { range: L }
        XL:  { range: XL }
        2XL: { range: 2XL }
        3XL: { range: 3XL }
        4XL: { range: 4XL }
        Low:    { range: XS-S,   write: false }
        Medium: { range: M-L,    write: false }
        High:   { range: XL-4XL, write: false, reads_as: 2XL }
  ingest:
    trusted:
      labels: [mintswarm]            # maintainer-only; never applied by an issue template
      authors: [zmij]
    match: any                       # any | all

design:
  store: issue_artifacts             # where design documents live

# A component may list reviewers: GitHub logins, bare (no "@"), requested on PRs that
# change its paths, for example `reviewers: [alice]`. Without them, pipeline.review.reviewers.
components:
  api:
    description: "contracts: proto definitions, generated OpenAPI and JSON Schemas, generated Rust code"
    paths: ["api/**", "crates/proto/**"]
  domain:
    description: "shared model and configuration types used by control plane and runner"
    paths: ["crates/domain/**", "crates/config/**", "crates/rules/**", "crates/github/**"]
  core:
    description: "control plane: store, scheduler, ingest, event log, tracker adapters, HTTP transcoding, server binary"
    paths: ["crates/core/**", "crates/server/**", "crates/steward/**"]
  runner:
    description: "runner daemon: stream client, worktrees, harness adapters, job MCP, gates, pusher; built-in probes and language-server definitions"
    paths: ["crates/runner/**", "defaults/probes/**", "defaults/lsp/**"]
  console-mcp:
    description: "console MCP server used from people's own agent sessions"
    paths: ["crates/console-mcp/**"]
  cli:
    description: "the mintswarm command-line client"
    paths: ["crates/cli/**"]
  web:
    description: "web UI and its generated API client"
    paths: ["web/**"]
  agents:
    description: "stage agent definitions, stage conventions, prompt templates and the dogfooding glue"
    paths: [".claude/agents/**", ".mintswarm/stages.md", ".mintswarm/stages/**", ".mintswarm/dogfood/**", "defaults/prompts/**", "defaults/packs/**", ".claude/skills/**"]
  distribution:
    description: "container image, compose files, service units and installers"
    paths: ["docker/**", "packaging/**", "compose.yaml", ".dockerignore"]
  tooling:
    description: "repository tasks, CI workflows and end-to-end tests"
    paths: ["xtask/**", ".github/**", "tests/**"]
  docs:
    description: "architecture documents, guides and the repository's top-level documents"
    paths: ["docs/**", "README.md", "CONTRIBUTING.md", "AGENTS.md", "CLAUDE.md", "LICENSE.md"]

shared:                              # any component may touch these
  - Cargo.toml
  - Cargo.lock
  - rust-toolchain.toml
  - deny.toml
  - .gitignore
  - .mintswarm/config.yaml
  - .editorconfig
  - rustfmt.toml
  - clippy.toml
  - .cargo/config.toml
  - pyproject.toml
  - .shellcheckrc

# Chooses the model at run time; the tier in .mintswarm/stages/<stage>.md is the stage default that .claude/agents/ is rendered with.
agents:
  default: { harness: claude, model: opus, effort: high }
  stages:
    assess: { model: sonnet }        # must differ from the plan stage's model (opus, through default)
    landing: { model: sonnet }       # must differ from the implement and review stages' model (opus, through default)
    gates: { model: sonnet, effort: low }

pipeline:
  # Read from the base ref, never the worktree, by the session, plan-approval/floor.py and plan-approval/decision.py.
  plan_approval:
    mode: shadow                     # always | shadow | judged | never
                                     # shadow: floor, assess and the decision run and are recorded on every plan, while a human decides
    require_human:                   # any declared match sends the plan to a human
      components: [agents]
      paths: [".mintswarm/config.yaml", ".mintswarm/dogfood/github/**", "AGENTS.md", "CLAUDE.md", ".github/workflows/**"]
    limits: { files: 10, lines: 300, new_files: 3 }
    limits_by_component: { domain: { lines: 2000, files: 15, new_files: 12 }, runner: { lines: 2000, files: 15, new_files: 12 } }  # <component>: { <limit>: N }; per-component values override the flat limits key by key
    non_production:                  # paths whose lines are not production lines: limits.lines counts production_lines when a declared file matches
      - "**/tests/**"
      - "**/*selftest*"
      - "**/test_*.py"
      - "**/*_test.*"
      - "**/*.test.*"
      - "**/*.spec.*"
      - "**/fixtures/**"
      - "**/Cargo.lock"
      - "**/pnpm-lock.yaml"
      - ".claude/agents/msw-*.md"    # rendered from .mintswarm/stages/
  # Read from the base ref, never the worktree, by landing/floor.py and landing/decision.py.
  landing:
    mode: shadow                     # always | shadow | judged | never
                                     # shadow: floor, landing stage and landing/decision.py run and are recorded on every PR, while a human decides
    require_human:                   # a matching changed path that the human-approved plan does not cover sends the change to a human
      paths: [".mintswarm/**", ".github/**", "AGENTS.md", "CLAUDE.md", ".claude/agents/**", ".claude/skills/**"]
    footprint: { lines_factor: 1.5 } # rounded down: the diff's production lines (paths matching no plan_approval.non_production glob)
                                     # up to production_lines × lines_factor, and all its lines up to estimated_lines × lines_factor
  # Read from the base ref, never the worktree, by the session, through dependencies/new-packages.py.
  dependencies:
    review: agent                    # agent | off; agent: the review stage judges each new or upgraded package
  # clear is read from the base ref, never the worktree, by the review, implement (address rounds) and landing stages.
  review:
    max_rounds: 5
    reviewers: [zmij]                # default reviewers of a PR; see components above
    clear: nit                       # blocker | major | minor | nit; findings at or above it must be cleared before the PR is ready; absent: major

gates:
  tests: selftests                   # only none forces plan approval
  run:
    - name: whitespace
      command: "git diff --check origin/master...HEAD"
    - name: agents-drift
      command: "python3 .mintswarm/dogfood/render-agents.py --check"
    - name: packs-check
      command: "python3 .mintswarm/dogfood/packs/pack.py check --base origin/master"
    - name: packs-selftest
      command: "python3 .mintswarm/dogfood/packs/selftest.py"
    - name: python-format
      command: "black --check . .mintswarm/dogfood/github/linux/yq .mintswarm/dogfood/msw-vcs .mintswarm/dogfood/hooks/pre-commit"
    - name: shell-lint
      command: "bash .mintswarm/dogfood/shell-lint.sh"
    - name: save-output-selftest
      command: "python3 .mintswarm/dogfood/save-output-selftest.py"
    - name: msw-vcs-selftest
      command: "python3 .mintswarm/dogfood/msw-vcs-selftest.py"
    - name: plan-approval-selftest
      command: "python3 .mintswarm/dogfood/plan-approval/selftest.py"
    - name: decomposition-approval-selftest
      command: "python3 .mintswarm/dogfood/decomposition-approval/selftest.py"
    - name: landing-floor-selftest
      command: "python3 .mintswarm/dogfood/landing/floor-selftest.py"
    - name: landing-facts-selftest
      command: "python3 .mintswarm/dogfood/landing/facts-selftest.py"
    - name: landing-judgement-selftest
      command: "python3 .mintswarm/dogfood/landing/judgement-selftest.py"
    - name: landing-decision-selftest
      command: "python3 .mintswarm/dogfood/landing/decision-selftest.py"
    - name: github-selftest
      command: "bash .mintswarm/dogfood/github/selftest.sh"
    - name: readiness-selftest
      command: "python3 .mintswarm/dogfood/readiness/selftest.py"
    - name: rust-format
      command: "cargo fmt --all --check"
    - name: rust-lint
      command: "cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings"
    - name: rust-test
      command: "cargo nextest run --workspace && cargo test --doc --workspace"
    - name: proto-lint
      command: "buf lint api/proto"
    - name: proto-breaking
      command: "git rev-parse --verify -q origin/master >/dev/null || { echo 'proto-breaking: origin/master not found; fetch it before running this gate'; exit 1; }; if git cat-file -e origin/master:api/proto/buf.yaml 2>/dev/null; then buf breaking api/proto --against '.git#ref=origin/master,subdir=api/proto'; else echo 'proto-breaking: origin/master has no api/proto yet; nothing to compare'; fi"
    - name: dependencies-selftest
      command: "python3 .mintswarm/dogfood/dependencies/selftest.py"
    - name: dependencies-prefetch-selftest
      command: "python3 .mintswarm/dogfood/dependencies/prefetch-selftest.py"
    - name: typescript-typecheck
      command: "bash .mintswarm/dogfood/web-install.sh && cd ./web && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit"
    - name: typescript-lint
      command: "bash .mintswarm/dogfood/web-install.sh && cd ./web && ./node_modules/.bin/eslint ."
    - name: typescript-format
      command: "bash .mintswarm/dogfood/web-install.sh && cd ./web && ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --check ."
    - name: typescript-test
      command: "bash .mintswarm/dogfood/web-install.sh && cd ./web/apps/ui && ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run"
    - name: commit-selftest
      command: "python3 .mintswarm/dogfood/commit-selftest.py"
  # Formatters that rewrite files, run on the paths a commit stages by .mintswarm/dogfood/commit.py
  # and its pre-commit hook; gate names the gates.run entry that checks the same formatting.
  format:
    - name: rust-format
      command: "cargo fmt --all"
      paths: ["**/*.rs"]
      gate: rust-format
    - name: python-format
      command: "black . .mintswarm/dogfood/github/linux/yq .mintswarm/dogfood/msw-vcs .mintswarm/dogfood/hooks/pre-commit"
      paths: ["**/*.py", ".mintswarm/dogfood/github/linux/yq", ".mintswarm/dogfood/msw-vcs", ".mintswarm/dogfood/hooks/pre-commit"]
      gate: python-format
    - name: typescript-format
      command: "bash .mintswarm/dogfood/web-install.sh && cd ./web && ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --write ."
      paths: ["web/**"]
      gate: typescript-format
  report:                            # read by the runner (report-gates.py), never by agents
    formats: [ctrf]                  # ctrf is always written; add a converter's format, e.g. junit (built in)
    # converters:                    # repository converters, contract in .mintswarm/dogfood/report-gates.py
    #   sarif: { command: [python3, .mintswarm/reporters/ctrf-to-sarif.py], extension: sarif }
